name: player_keeptradecut_value year axis clamps a future opening day to now (executed-result parity)
description: A season whose opening day has not arrived yet puts both the as-of boundary and the 30-day recency floor ahead of every observation the feed holds, so the window is empty and the column renders NULL for every player. Measured on production 2026-08-03: the 2026 window was [2026-08-10, 2026-09-09] against a latest observation of 2026-08-03, so a year-split KTC column was blank for all 533 players that otherwise carried a value, and would have been blank from January through August 10 of every year. Seed a season whose opening day is two years out, a fresh player observed 3 days ago (inside the window ending at now()) and a stale player observed 200 days ago (outside it). The fresh player's value must read populated and the stale player's must read NULL, which pins both halves: that the boundary is clamped to now(), and that the recency floor still applies relative to the clamped end. Fails at HEAD without the LEAST(..., now()) clamp in year_axis_boundary -- both players then read NULL.
expected_query: with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2025]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years WHERE player.primary_position IN ('MLB')), "td38df019112bff5927d902cdd86623fe" as (select distinct on (ktc_src.pid, ktc_od.year) ktc_src.pid, ktc_od.year, ktc_src.keeptradecut_value from opening_days ktc_od inner join keeptradecut_valuations ktc_src on ktc_src.is_superflex = true and ktc_src.keeptradecut_value is not null and ktc_src.observed_at <= LEAST(date_trunc('day', ktc_od.opening_day) + interval '0 year', now()) and ktc_src.observed_at > (LEAST(date_trunc('day', ktc_od.opening_day) + interval '0 year', now()) - interval '30 days') order by ktc_src.pid, ktc_od.year, ktc_src.observed_at desc) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "tfcfc9eab80a063fa2009382eef2a8970"."keeptradecut_value" AS "player_keeptradecut_value_0", "player_years"."year", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "td38df019112bff5927d902cdd86623fe" as "tfcfc9eab80a063fa2009382eef2a8970" on "tfcfc9eab80a063fa2009382eef2a8970"."pid" = "player"."pid" and tfcfc9eab80a063fa2009382eef2a8970.year = (player_years.year) where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "tfcfc9eab80a063fa2009382eef2a8970"."keeptradecut_value", "player_years"."year", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
